title: Auto repair
description: An automotive repair and bodywork training workshop with a passenger-car service bay, two-post lift, frame-repair bench, paint-booth entrance and wheel-service equipment. Along the tiled walls are tool panels, steel workbenches and drawer cabinets, with jacks, an oil-drain caddy, utility carts and parts storage around the bays; the hatchback's hood is raised above its engine bay.

tasks.text: Pick up the leftmost of the three sockets on the workbench, marked 19. Set it down in the middle of the freestanding red rolling toolbox’s top, then slide it to the right across the toolbox top and leave it at rest within reach.

locatorSteps.label: Pick up the leftmost socket, marked 19.
Set it in the middle of the toolbox top.
Slide the socket to the right and let it stop.

tasks.text: On the freestanding red rolling toolbox beside the workbench, slide the empty tool tray to the right. Pick up the rightmost of the three sockets on the workbench, marked 21, and set it down on the cleared left side of the toolbox top.

locatorSteps.label: Slide the empty tray to the right on the toolbox top.
Pick up the rightmost socket, marked 21.
Set it on the cleared left side of the toolbox top.

tasks.text: Raise the saddle on the low red trolley jack. Press down lightly on the saddle and check that it stays raised and level. Lower it to its starting height and leave the jack’s base in place.

locatorSteps.label: Raise the saddle on the red jack.
Press lightly and check that the saddle holds level.
Lower the saddle to its starting height.

tasks.text: Unlatch the aisle-side front door of the hatchback car on the two-post lift. Swing the door open and lower its window. With the window down, swing the door partly shut and open it again. Raise the window, close the door fully and seat the latch. Leave nearby equipment in place.

locatorSteps.label: Unlatch and open the aisle-side front door.
Lower the window in the open door.
Swing the door partly shut, then open it again.
Raise the window.
Close the door fully and seat the latch.

tasks.text: Use the red two-post lift to raise the hatchback car and check that it holds level. Remove the five lug nuts from the front wheel nearest the aisle. Pull the wheel clear of the hub, carry it away, lay it flat on the floor and let go. Lift it again, turn it upright, align it on the same hub and refasten all five lug nuts. Lower the car until all four lift pads support it. Leave nearby equipment in place.

locatorSteps.label: Raise the car and check that it holds level.
Remove all five lug nuts from the aisle-side front wheel.
Pull the wheel off its hub and carry it clear.
Lay it flat on the floor and let go.
Lift the wheel, turn it upright and align it on its hub.
Refit the wheel and fasten all five lug nuts.
Lower the car until all four lift pads support it.

tasks.text: Open the top drawer of the freestanding red rolling toolbox beside the workbench with the three sockets. Put the middle socket, marked 17, into the drawer, then add the torque wrench from the same workbench. Close the drawer and reopen it to check that both tools stayed inside. Close it again and leave the surrounding tools in place.

locatorSteps.label: Open the top drawer of the freestanding red toolbox.
Pick up the middle socket, marked 17.
Put the socket in the open drawer.
Pick up the torque wrench from the same workbench.
Put the wrench in the drawer and close it.
Reopen the drawer and check that both tools stayed inside.
Close the drawer again.

tasks.text: Roll the red oil-drain caddy (Oildrain) from its storage spot beside the lift into the clear aisle behind the hatchback car. Let it stop upright, then raise its funnel. Give the funnel a light touch and check that it holds its height and stays level. Lower the funnel, roll the caddy back to its original spot and leave it upright and still, with nearby equipment in place.

locatorSteps.label: Roll the caddy behind the car and let it stop upright.
Raise the funnel.
Touch it lightly and check that it holds level.
Lower the funnel.
Return the caddy to its storage spot and let it stop.

tasks.text: Take the leftmost bolt from the blue parts tray on the freestanding red toolbox. Set it on the slatted insert inside the open red parts washer (Partswasher) on the workbench. Close the lid and leave the bolt covered for a moment. Reopen the lid, check that the bolt stayed in the basin and return it to its original spot in the blue tray. Close the washer and leave nearby objects in place.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the leftmost bolt from the blue tray.
Place the bolt on the slatted insert in the basin.
Close the lid and leave the bolt covered briefly.
Reopen the lid and check that the bolt stayed inside.
Lift the bolt out of the basin.
Return it to its original spot in the blue tray.
Close the washer lid.

tasks.text: On the workbench with the row of sockets, lift the front edge of the large tan masking cloth clear of the bench lip. Pull the hanging edge back onto the work surface, then let go and let the cloth settle on the bench.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the tan cloth’s front edge clear of the bench lip.
Pull the edge onto the workbench, release it and let it settle.

tasks.text: Find the small blue cloth beside the large tan masking cloth on the workbench with the row of sockets. Lift the blue cloth’s front edge, pull it farther onto the work surface and let go. Leave it resting on the bench.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the front edge of the small blue cloth.
Pull the edge farther onto the bench, then release it.
